title: A-727 column shift: gear selector linkage adjustment (1976-77 Dodge W/D trucks)
summary: Army procedure for setting the column shift rod so detents line up and the truck only starts in P or N.
warnings: From the Army manual for the M880 (military 1976-77 Dodge W200/D200). Confirm a civilian truck has the same part before using a number.

steps.text: Assemble all linkage parts but leave the adjustable rod end free.
Put the column selector in P.
Move the selector lever on the transmission all the way to the rear, into the P detent.
Set the adjustable rod to length and install it with no load in either direction on the linkage.

Check: the lever moves easily and every position is clearly felt; in N and D the detent is close enough to the gate stops that the lever won't stay out of detent when released against the gate; the engine only starts in P or N.
Tighten the adjustment swivel lock bolt to 125 in-lb.

sources.title: TM 9-2320-266-34: Direct and General Support Maintenance Manual, Truck, Cargo, 1-1/4 Ton, 4x4 (M880 series)
sources.publisher: Headquarters, Department of the Army, January 1976 (reprint with Changes 1-7)
